evidence: Labeled Docs and updates doc/zmq.md with documentation of ZMQ reorg and mempool eviction behavior.
rationale: The PR documents previously undocumented ZMQ notification semantics during chain reorganizations and mempool evictions in doc/zmq.md and adds functional test verification. External client developers previously had to deduce notification guarantees directly from C++ source code, providing clear and worthwhile value for downstream integrations.
